name: Studio internal quality rubric
disclaimer: An internal assessment by the studio's own tools and reviewers. It is not proof of quality, not a public number and not a prediction of views. A failed hard gate blocks release whatever the score.
releaseRule: Release needs every hard gate passed and a score of 95 or more. Neither replaces the other.

howMeasured.auto: Scored by films/channels/studio/tools/qa_episode.py with no person involved. 'needs' says whether the delivered video is enough ('video') or a file beside it must exist ('sidecar'). All listed checks pass: full points. Any fails: 0. A check that could not be read: not scored, listed for a person.
howMeasured.builder: Scored by the channel's builder from the evidence named.
howMeasured.coordinator: Scored by the coordinator (the reviewer) from frame grabs, the contact sheet and the files named. Agents cannot hear or watch at speed, so no sound or motion-feel judgment is theirs.
howMeasured.owner: Scored by the owner, or recorded for the owner in the owner's own words.

scoring: Whole points only, from 0 to the criterion's maximum.
Full points need the evidence named. No evidence means 0, not a guess.
People's scores go in review/rubric-scores.json (qa_episode.py --blank-scores prints the form) and are read with --scores.
A person may settle a check the tool could only list (result 'review') or could not read ('not checked'). A person cannot overrule a measured fail.
The total is given only when every criterion is scored. Until then the report shows the points still open.
formatsNote: The thresholds qa_episode.py applies per format. lengthS is the hard window, targetS the aim. This block is the authority; the tool carries a copy for when this file is missing.

hardGates.name: Delivery size
hardGates.rule: The picture is the format's delivery size: 1080x1920 for 9:16, 2560x1440 for a long video. A file named -youtube.mp4 may be 1440x2560 and is always labelled an upscale.
hardGates.source: kits/cinema/film/qa.py (1080x1920); kits/cinema/film/compilation.mjs (2560x1440 long video); kits/cinema/film/youtube1440.py (the 1440x2560 YouTube file is an upscale)
hardGates.fix: Wrong tier or aspect: re-assemble from the right chunks. Never scale a master to pass this gate.

hardGates.name: Frame rate
hardGates.rule: 30 frames a second, constant.
hardGates.source: kits/cinema/film/scorecard.py (format target: 30 fps CFR); kits/cinema/film/render.mjs
hardGates.fix: Re-assemble with kits/cinema/film/render.mjs --assemble; do not re-time the file.

hardGates.name: Length
hardGates.rule: Inside the format's window. short: 60 to 75.5 s. part: 61 to 75.5 s. premium: 60 to 90.5 s (target 70 to 90). long: 8:30 to 11:00 (target 8:30 to 9:30).
hardGates.source: short 60 to 75.5 s: kits/cinema/film/qa.py. part 1:01 to 1:15 and premium 70 to 90 s, never under 60: films/channels/SEASON-FORMAT.md, with qa.py's half-second allowance. long: at least 8:30 (SEASON-FORMAT.md), at most 11 min (kits/cinema/film/compilation.mjs)
hardGates.fix: Too short: add real content (a fact-checked line, a bridge), never a longer hold or slower voice. Too long: cut a decorative line. Then rebuild only the shots after the change.

hardGates.name: Loudness
hardGates.rule: Integrated loudness of the delivered AAC: -15 to -13 LUFS (9:16), -15.5 to -12.5 LUFS (long).
hardGates.source: 9:16: -15 to -13 LUFS, kits/cinema/film/qa.py. long: -14 LUFS within 1.5, kits/cinema/film/compilation.mjs. Measured with ffmpeg ebur128, as the kit does
hardGates.fix: Re-master the sound (kits/cinema/studio/render.py) and re-assemble. The picture is not re-rendered.

hardGates.name: True peak
hardGates.rule: At most -1 dBTP on the delivered AAC.
hardGates.source: at most -1 dBTP on the delivered AAC: kits/cinema/film/qa.py, compilation.mjs
hardGates.fix: Re-master with a lower ceiling and re-assemble. The picture is not re-rendered.

hardGates.name: Picture against sound
hardGates.rule: Picture and sound are the same length: within one frame (9:16), within 0.1 s (long).
hardGates.source: 9:16: within one frame, kits/cinema/film/qa.py. long: within 0.1 s, compilation.mjs
hardGates.fix: Re-assemble. If the sound is long, trim the music tail in the cue sheet, not the file.

hardGates.name: Phone speaker
hardGates.rule: Left/right correlation at least 0.3 and at most 3 dB lost when folded to mono.
hardGates.source: correlation at least 0.3 and fold-down loss at most 3 dB: kits/cinema/film/qa.py. compilation.mjs has no such gate, so a long video is measured but not gated
hardGates.fix: Narrow the stem that cancels (studio preset), re-master, re-assemble.

hardGates.name: Flashing
hardGates.rule: At most 3 flashes in any one second (large-area luminance swings).
hardGates.source: at most 3 flashes in any second; a transition is a luminance change of 0.1 or more, darker side under 0.8, over 25% of the frame: kits/cinema/film/qa.py (WCAG 2.3.1)
hardGates.fix: Find the frames in the report, soften or slow that one transition, re-render its chunk.

hardGates.name: No dead air
hardGates.rule: No stretch of 1.2 s or more below -40 dB in the delivered mix.
hardGates.source: studio standing gate: no silence of 1.2 s or more (films/channels/CTA.md, 'the voice-gap rule'); -40 dB on the delivered mix is this tool's setting
hardGates.fix: Carry the gap with room tone, score or picture-led sound in the cue sheet; re-master and re-assemble.

hardGates.name: No frozen picture
hardGates.rule: No frozen stretch of 1.4 s or more, except the end card (a hold that reaches the last 3 s, at most 8 s). A long video joined from episodes with narrated cards is run with --cards and a person confirms each card.
hardGates.source: studio standing gate: no frozen picture over about 1.4 s except the end card (channels ran freezedetect on drafts). Noise -60 dB is ffmpeg's default. The end-card allowance (reaches the last 3 s, at most 8 s: the longest card kits/cinema/film/compilation.mjs draws) is this tool's setting
hardGates.fix: Give the shot a motivated move or a developing picture and re-render its chunk. A frozen render (a bug) is rendered fresh, not resumed.

hardGates.name: Frame 0 is composed
hardGates.rule: 9:16: the first frame is not blank or black. A long video may fade in from black, with at most 0.5 s of blank picture.
hardGates.source: .claude/skills/cinema-kit/SKILL.md: frame 0 is already composed (9:16: the platform cover is a frame of the video). A long video may fade in from black; the half-second limit is this tool's setting, set after the delivered Skin Sense Season 2 long video, which opens on one black frame
hardGates.fix: Start the first shot on its composed picture (transitionIn 'open'); re-render chunk 0.

hardGates.name: File size
hardGates.rule: At most 95 MB, so the file can be committed.
hardGates.source: kits/cinema/film/compilation.mjs fails over 95 MB (GitHub refuses 100 MB)
hardGates.fix: Re-assemble at the capped rate (compilation.mjs --max-mb, youtube1440.py's budget). Never commit a split file.

hardGates.name: Voiceless gaps
hardGates.rule: No voiceless gap over 1.2 s on the dialogue stem before the end card. On a long film a person confirms each longer gap is a picture-only beat.
hardGates.signsOff: tool; coordinator on a long film
hardGates.source: voiceless gaps of at most 1.2 s on the dialogue stem at -42 dB: One More Orbit season2/gaps.py, films/channels/CTA.md. One frame of tolerance is this tool's setting
hardGates.fix: Close the gap in the voice layout (pause lengths), or add a fact-checked line; rebuild captions and the shots after it.

hardGates.name: Text inside the safe box
hardGates.rule: The render's text audit has 0 warnings.
hardGates.signsOff: tool; builder by frame grabs where no audit exists
hardGates.source: 0 text-audit warnings: kits/cinema/film/qa.py, from the render's audit.json
hardGates.fix: Move or shorten the one label in the compile step; re-render the chunks that show it.

hardGates.name: Sound on the picture
hardGates.rule: Every transient within one frame of its picture event (the studio's qa.json).
hardGates.source: transients within one frame of their picture event: kits/cinema/studio/qa.py
hardGates.fix: Fix the cue's time in the event table, run kits/cinema/studio/render.py again, re-assemble.

hardGates.name: Claims are marked honestly
hardGates.rule: No claim is marked ok unless a person opened its source. A search excerpt stays OPEN.
hardGates.source: films/channels/STUDIO-STYLE.md: a claim is OK only when a person has opened the source; a search excerpt stays OPEN
hardGates.fix: Set the claim back to open. Only the person who opened the page sets ok.

hardGates.name: Chapters
hardGates.rule: A long video's chapters: first at 0:00, in order, each at least 10 s, computed from segment starts; each line equals one part's title exactly.
hardGates.signsOff: tool for the timings; builder for the titles
hardGates.source: kits/cinema/film/compilation.mjs: the first chapter at 0:00, each at least 10 s, starts computed from segment starts; prism-studio links parts by exact chapter titles
hardGates.fix: Regenerate chapters.txt from the build's segment starts; never type a time by hand. Fix a title in the part, not in the list.

hardGates.name: Sources opened
hardGates.rule: Before export, a person has opened every source and every claim is ok.
hardGates.source: films/channels/STUDIO-STYLE.md; films/channels/studio/tools/validate.py (nothing is exported while sources are open)
hardGates.fix: The owner or a reviewer opens the remaining links. A claim that fails is reworded or cut, and its shot rebuilt.

hardGates.name: Look gate
hardGates.rule: The owner approved the look (stills; for Skin Sense Season 3 also a 10 s clip) before the full render.
hardGates.source: films/channels/SEASON-FORMAT.md; .claude/skills/cinema-kit/SKILL.md (stills before the full render)
hardGates.fix: Send stills. Change only what the owner names, then ask again.

hardGates.name: Packaging
hardGates.rule: packaging.json holds five titles, three thumbnails, three pairings and a winner, and every check is true.
hardGates.signsOff: builder; the owner chooses the title
hardGates.source: films/channels/PACKAGING.md: five titles, three thumbnails, three pairings, a winner, every check true
hardGates.fix: Revise the pairing whose check is false. Never ship with a false check.

hardGates.name: The (a) to (h) gate
hardGates.rule: Scored 1 to 5 by a reviewer: nothing under 3; (a), (g) and (h) at 4 or more; nothing factual or ethical open.
hardGates.source: films/channels/STUDIO-STYLE.md, 'Quality gate'
hardGates.fix: Return to the stage behind the low axis: (a) hook shot, (c)(d) camera keys, (g) last shot, (h) materials and light.

hardGates.name: Text discipline
hardGates.rule: At most two text blocks on screen at once, besides the series line, badges and disclaimers; one idea at a time.
hardGates.source: Owner's Season 2 rule: Possibility Lab declutter.py; films/channels/CTA.md ('the 2-text-block rule')
hardGates.fix: Drop or shorten the extra block in the compile step (Possibility Lab: declutter.py); re-render the chunks that show it.

hardGates.name: Captions follow the voice
hardGates.rule: Captions are built from the measured words of the delivered voice, and three spot checks agree with the sound.
hardGates.source: kits/cinema/voice/align.py and the channel compile step build captions from the measured words; .claude/skills/cinema-kit/SKILL.md (sync)
hardGates.fix: Run align.py on the final voice and rebuild captions; re-render (captions are in the picture).

hardGates.name: Truth and labels
hardGates.rule: Nothing is presented as a photo; AI voice and AI illustrations are disclosed; hypotheses, thought experiments and idealisations are labelled; the title and thumbnail claim no more than the script.
hardGates.source: films/channels/PACKAGING.md, 'Truth rules'; films/channels/studio/README.md, 'Never claim a technique we did not use'
hardGates.fix: Add the label or the hedge. If the title overstates, pick another pairing.

hardGates.name: Channel rules
hardGates.rule: Every rule and prohibition in the channel's identity file holds (for Skin Sense: one skin tone, never a face, no risk words over skin, 'Education, not medical advice', no brands).
hardGates.source: films/channels/studio/identities/<slug>.json, 'rules' and 'never'; films/channels/SEASON-FORMAT.md
hardGates.fix: Fix the one shot or line that breaks the rule.

hardGates.name: Owner's approval
hardGates.rule: The owner has seen the episode and said it can be posted. Nothing posts by itself.
hardGates.source: films/channels/STUDIO-STYLE.md ('Nothing posts without the owner'); prism-studio/CLAUDE.md
hardGates.fix: Apply the owner's notes shot by shot and ask again.

criteria.text: The claims ledger is complete: every claim has its sentence, source link and title, access date, how it was verified and a status; none needs rewording.
A person has opened every source. Every claim is ok; none rests on a search excerpt.
criteria.evidence: claims.json statuses; the review/claims-table.md column 'what the source actually says'

criteria.text: Every number heard matches the screen, the source and calc.py. Hedges go exactly as far as the source.
criteria.evidence: script.md against claims.json and calc.json; frame grabs of each figure

criteria.text: Each shot shows its principle truthfully: scale and direction are right, idealisations carry a badge, thought experiments say so.
criteria.evidence: shots.json 'principle' against frame grabs of each shot

criteria.text: The hook, title and thumbnail promise no more than the script proves.
criteria.evidence: packaging.json winner against script.md and claims.json

criteria.text: The file is the format's size at 30 fps constant, H.264 yuv420p with AAC sound.
All text sits inside the safe box: the render's text audit has no warnings.
Frame grabs at the key moments are clean: no banding, jagged edges, clipped highlights, z-fighting or popping; captions hold 4.5:1.
criteria.evidence: frame grabs at full size; kits/cinema/sci/contrast.py

criteria.text: Production value: no default 3-D render, template or stock look.
Every technique, size and number named in the notes and in shots.json was really used and is labelled honestly (for example '1440 upscale').
criteria.evidence: shots.json, the build log, films/channels/studio/README.md 'Never claim'

criteria.text: No more than 3 flashes in any second.
The picture never freezes for 1.4 s or more, except the end card.
Frame 0 is composed: no blank or black lead-in.
No flicker, shimmer, popping or jitter from frame to frame.
criteria.evidence: consecutive frames stepped across every cut and at three other points

criteria.text: Palette and type are the channel's own, and the season look matches the approved still.
criteria.evidence: frame grabs against identities/<slug>.json and the approved still

criteria.text: The owner approved the look before the full render.
criteria.evidence: episode.json status.lookGate, and where the approval was given

criteria.text: The channel's signature devices are present, and light and materials stay the same from shot to shot.
At most two text blocks at once; one idea on screen.
criteria.evidence: frame grabs at every label change

criteria.text: Nothing borrowed from another channel's or client's identity.
criteria.evidence: theme tokens and fonts used by the scene

criteria.text: The plan holds together: shot windows run in order with no gap or overlap, and every join is named the same from both sides.
The viewer always knows where they are: each shot starts where the last one ended, and scale jumps are bridged.
criteria.evidence: the last frame of each shot beside the first frame of the next

criteria.text: The episode is composed for its own aspect, with the subject and all text inside the safe area.
criteria.evidence: frame grabs with the safe box drawn

criteria.text: Every camera move has a reason.
criteria.evidence: shots.json camera and purpose against the frames

criteria.text: The picture moves with the sentence, at the format's rhythm (a meaningful change every 2 to 4 s; slower, but never frozen, for ASMR lessons).
Focus sits on what the line names; one focal point per frame; the last frame works as a poster.
criteria.evidence: frame grabs at each focus change and the last frame

criteria.text: The script passes the lint for its format: grade 8 or lower per beat, no sentence over 22 words, pace and length inside the profile.
No dead air: no stretch of 1.2 s or more below -40 dB in the mix.
Understood on the first listen: one idea per sentence, terms explained in the same breath, about four spoken numbers; the voice carries meaning and the screen carries figures.
criteria.evidence: script.md read once, aloud in the head; review/clarity-review.md

criteria.text: Captions follow the delivered voice word for word and in time, and carry the channel's required lines.
criteria.evidence: captions built from vo/words.json; three spot checks

criteria.text: The hook: by 2.0 s a question is spoken and the picture already shows the subject.
One thread from hook to payoff, with open loops and a steady rhythm.
The ending delivers the promised answer; the like/follow line comes after the payoff, never in the first 20 s.
The length lands inside the format's target window.
The packaging is complete and every check is true.
Loudness inside the window and true peak at most -1 dBTP on the delivered AAC.
Mono-safe, and picture and sound the same length.
Every sound lands on its picture event, and the voice sits at least 10 LU over the music.
A listen on a phone speaker and on headphones: the voice is clear, nothing rings or clicks, and the channel's sound rules hold.
criteria.evidence: the owner's listen; agents cannot hear, so nobody else may score this

criteria.text: Files are named and placed as STRUCTURE.md says, so Prism and the next builder find them.
New scene code that will be needed again lives in the channel's set/ folder, and LIBRARY.md lists it.
The Episode Intelligence Report is written, with measured facts apart from hypotheses.
The build can be repeated from the folder: the commands are recorded and the render log shows verified chunks.
criteria.evidence: the report's command list; the render log
